primary: All ten scheduled original observations per task/profile; arithmetic mean score on the frozen 0-10 rubric and separate arithmetic mean resource scopes. Equal task weights for the five-task macro. No data-dependent task or trial deletion in the primary result.
quality: Show individual points, task/profile mean, median, sample SD and paired score difference. Preserve critical/citation gates separately. Genuine unresolved rubric judgments remain null with explicit lower/upper score bounds; do not convert unknown to zero or pass. Record missing/failed answers and scheduled counts without replacement or favorable-subset inference.
pr261_compatibility: Separate secondary view: one lowest and one highest score per task/profile, unchanged deterministic original trial-index ties, and exactly those retained tuples for all resource metrics. Recompute selection inside every original-pair bootstrap draw. Five-task MAD screening is a diagnostic, with its original five-task and zero-MAD guards and no refitting. Show all excluded identities and the complete five-task result alongside it.
predeclared_robust_sensitivity: Within each fixed task, use all original paired score differences and positive resource log-ratios. Report their median and a symmetric one-per-tail Winsorized mean of those paired contrasts. Each contrast uses both profiles from the same repetition; no selection using which profile wins or its quality score. Keep the raw arithmetic-mean estimand primary and label the different contrast estimands. No robust method silently replaces original observations.

bootstrap.unit: whole original baseline/zg pair within each fixed task

filter_review: Use retained historical cohorts, frozen synthetic examples and the current complete cohort to assess ties, changed estimands, pair retention, bias/dispersion tradeoffs, interval widths, task influence and N=5 screening sensitivity. Findings after model execution are separately labelled; never select a method because it makes zg look better.
validity: Keep original execution, source-only, relevant retrieval and accounting checks visible for every scheduled trial. Filtering cannot repair a failure or unknown. Distinguish numeric descriptive results from conclusions requiring valid evidence. Report scope and missing counts even if a statistical view excludes an observation.
scope: Repeatability on the five accepted previously observed questions and pinned stack. Pointwise intervals do not establish population generalization or a multiple-comparison guarantee. Reported cache-inclusive input is not provider billing; cold full-slot time includes setup/indexing.
